checkpoint: P2 canonical wire and governance-pinned DeFMI VM settlement verification
source_match: All final manifest source bytes match the isolated local worktrees. Four Cargo.lock files changed during the last verification command and were imported with before/after hash checks.
changes: Canonical bounded ML-DSA quorum approval encoding rejects truncation, trailing bytes, unsupported suite/version and unordered/duplicate signers.

Hybrid zkPI and typed zkPI retain both components. A venue requires its caller-enrolled committee, verifies both signature components and applies live key validity. Explicit classical decoding remains available for historical/compatibility records.
QOMM real proof coordinator and seven-node command now retain PQ approvals for payment and typed authorization; the seven-node command delegates DKG and signing to the canonical coordinator.
Handoff archives verify signature integrity without using the current clock to retroactively invalidate historical records; execution always uses a live enrolled policy.

DeFMI registered verifier statements, native SQLite records, VM records/state roots and RPC readback bind the PQ policy. VM product settlement requires the registered three-of-seven committee, never a key supplied by a settlement.
Populated legacy verifier stores fail before schema migration; no missing key is guessed and no ledger entry is deleted. Empty legacy verifier tables can acquire the new column.
Aethel changes in this checkpoint are verifier fixture compatibility only. Application ownership and foundation independence are unchanged.

verification.checks: All-target check and Clippy -D warnings for qomm-defmi, qomm-avalanche-vm, qomm-harness, qomm-transport, qomm-zkpi, aethel-defmi-host; crypto all-feature/all-target Clippy. QOMM demo checks its library and four real binaries, excluding the pre-existing helper auto-binary.
verification.evidence_limits: Deterministic real-cryptography regression tests. No new native engine, WAN, live chain or comparative performance experiment.

remaining: The full migration remains in progress. P1 note-opening confidentiality and WAN performance gates remain open.
P2 node keys currently identify cryptographic bootstrap identities, not yet DeKYX-confirmed legal operators. Enrollment, authorized rotation and revocation propagation remain unfinished.

OCLOB application certificates, Aethel receivable certificates, native facility caller-supplied venue paths, standing-pool approvals and other governance/credential/clearing boundaries still require PQ approval integration.

No post-change live Avalanche or seven-operator/WAN acceptance has run. The node lifecycle test signs an explicit health statement; the VM settlement test uses real cryptography with test-generated keys.
FROST, Pedersen commitments, range/anonymous proofs and TLS certificate authentication remain classical. Independent ML-DSA approvals do not make those primitives post-quantum.
P3-P6 credentials, clearing, cross-domain trust, hash-based audit proofs, checkpoint signing, key retirement and recovery gates remain open.
Dependency overlays remain unpublished and are not a release-ready immutable multi-repository dependency graph.
